The discussion explores using derived (virtual) columns to represent non-materialized fields in Iceberg v4, leveraging the expression spec to store deterministic transformations in metadata. Participants consider reusing sort order and group statistics for indexing, and emphasize that the metadata must fully describe the function’s operation so optimizers can rewrite queries.
